label: pjm 48 sync srmc
definition: pjm 47 sync-srmc: PJM coal rebuild step 3a (online%-scaled synchronization forcing) on the FULL re-derived thermal tranches. Steps 1+2+3a stacked on the keeper: coal_takeorpay_from_data (measured EIA-923 Sch-5 sunk share) + coal_mustrun_online_pmin (min-load band sized to the measured online-net-MW Pmin) + coal_sync_srmc_tranche (split that band by the contract share into a fuel-free _mustrun floor + a full-SRMC _sync band, both forced ON via min_gen). NEW this run: the forcing is ONLINE%-SCALED via a re-derived plant-level online_frac column (hours any unit synchronized / 8760) — supercriticals (~1.0) held all 8760 h, two-shifting cyclers forced only in their top-online_frac hours by system load (mirrors the CT must-run load-shaping). The thermal_tranches_PJM.csv was fully re-derived 2023-25, which also corrected the pre-NaN-fix online_hours / committed_pct / mustrun_online_pct for every multi-unit coal+gas plant (CLAUDE.md #12 accurate data). Subbit sigmoid retuned to v3 (ceil 1.65->2.10 / slope 1.4->3.0). RESULTS vs pjm_46 keeper (-7.9/+0.1/+7.5): online%-scaling FIXES the 2023 over-hold (coal +5.5%->-0.1%, all classes in C2 tol); the accurate re-derive (lower committed band) deepens the cheapest-gas 2024 under-run to -9.3% (bit floor VERIFIED saturated: 0.68->0.76->0.90 leaves 2024 bit at -9.4%, so it is NOT an offer-curve lever — the residual is the step-3b reserve co-opt gap that carries the dear-gas/scarcity volume, memory-blocked per Thread D); 2025 +8.7% (subbit cyclers 876/879 +25% the dominant per-class miss, dear-gas reserve co-opt the lever). Structurally the most complete coal representation (steps 1-3a); residual attributed to the blocked step-3b, not offer-curve fudging. Still NOT-YET pending step-3b. Solved 2023-25 serial, merged.
